# Decision tree

[Previous: Influence diagram](./influence_diagram.md) | [Workflow](../workflow.md) | [Next: Compact tree](./compact_tree.md)

Explore the model as sequences of decisions and uncertain outcomes. Expand only the branches needed to follow a path or check a calculation. See [Decision trees](../../domain/decision_tree.md) for interpreting branches, policies, and expected values.

## Choose the tree view

### Open the tree view selector

Select **Decision Tree** in the sidebar to choose a tree representation of the model.

![Decision Tree sidebar entry](<../figures/decision_tree/button - Decision Tree.png>)

### Choose a tree representation

Choose **Tree**, **Compact**, or **Solution** to view the model in the corresponding tree representation.

![Decision Tree view selector popup](<../figures/decision_tree/popup - Decision Tree.png>)

### Explore the decision tree

Use the decision tree to examine the model as sequences of decisions and uncertain outcomes.

![Decision tree page](<../figures/decision_tree/page - Decision tree.png>)

## Navigate, expand, and collapse branches

### Navigate the decision tree

Use the toolbar to zoom, fit the tree to the viewport, expand visible branches, and read value metrics.

![Decision tree toolbar](<../figures/decision_tree/menu - Decision tree toolbar.png>)

### Expand one branch

Select the plus button at the end of a branch to reveal the next decisions or uncertain outcomes along that path. Repeat on other plus buttons to explore additional branches.

![Plus button at the end of a decision tree branch](<../figures/decision_tree/button - Expand node.png>)

### Expand visible tree branches

Select **Expand All** to expand all currently visible expansion nodes; repeat as needed to explore deeper levels.

![Expand All button in the decision tree](<../figures/decision_tree/button - Expand All.png>)

### Collapse an expanded branch

Select the collapse control on an expanded branch to hide that branch and its descendants. Plus placeholders reappear where more detail can be expanded; collapsing changes only the view, not the model inputs.

![Collapse control on an expanded decision-tree branch](<../figures/decision_tree/button - Collapse branch.png>)

## Recognize branch-end symbols

### Recognize a pruned branch

The **scissors** symbol marks a **pruned branch**, shown with a dashed connecting line. This path is excluded from further expansion, for example because an outcome has zero probability given the preceding path or a model restriction rules it out. It is not a terminal result, a collapsed branch, or a button for deleting part of the model. Unlike a plus placeholder, it cannot be expanded.

![Scissors symbol at the end of a dashed, pruned decision-tree branch](<../figures/decision_tree/card - Pruned branch.png>)

### Recognize a leaf node

The **envelope-shaped** symbol marks a **leaf (terminal) node**: this path has reached its result, with no further decisions or outcomes to expand. Read **Value** and, when displayed, **Cumulative probability** beside it. Select the symbol to highlight the complete path to that leaf; select the root node to clear the highlight. A plus placeholder means more detail remains hidden, while scissors indicate a pruned path rather than a terminal result.

![Envelope-shaped leaf symbol beside the terminal value and cumulative probability](<../figures/decision_tree/card - Leaf node.png>)

## Select or clear a path

Select a decision or uncertainty node to highlight the path leading to it. To remove the highlight, select the root decision node.

![A selected path highlighted in the decision tree](<../figures/decision_tree/page - Decision tree selected path.png>)

## Check branch values near a leaf

On uncertainty branches, **Prob** is the probability of that outcome, shown as a decimal, and **Utility** is the utility assigned to the branch. In this example,

$$
0.25 \times 100 + 0.50 \times 75 + 0.25 \times 25 = 68.75,
$$

matching the **EV** beside the uncertainty node. At each leaf, **Value** is the terminal value and **Cumulative probability** is the probability of the full path. Expand only as far as needed to check a path.

![Branch values and leaf calculation details in the decision tree](<../figures/decision_tree/page - Decision tree leaf check.png>)

## Review calculated results

Compare the tree's base and scenario expected values with the influence diagram using the same model inputs and selections. For a path-level check, read the branch probability and utility, leaf value and cumulative probability, and the expected value shown beside a tree node. Resolve validation warnings and unintended conditional selections before treating a difference as a modelling conclusion.

![Expected-value metrics in the decision tree](<../figures/decision_tree/card - Expected value metrics.png>)
